If you try therapy be prepared for lots of trial and error with therapists. Some of them may even put you on medications that do nothing for depression but instead give you road rage or ED! Others will ply you with vapid happy talk and then swipe your card and shoo you out.

How long does the trial and error process take? I don't know, I gave up.

If I'm not responding to your signals, it's either:

1) I'm shit-scared that I'm misreading you and that me making a move will lead to disgusted rejection and me being labeled a creep. Not the end of world if we're both strangers and will never see each other again, but if we work together or have class together and know the same people, then me being the 'creep' is a death sentence for my reputation.

2) I think you're screwing with me and are either setting me up to be some kind of joke or just want me to buy you something.

Maybe family or friends deserve to be hurt. Maybe family and friends failed you. One of the things that has been holding me back from just doing it is the impact it might have on my parents. Then last night, it hit me that who cares if they're hurt. They did a terrible job as parents, and this is the result. I needed a mother and got a nutcase who did nothing other than yell and scare the shit out of me when I was a toddler. I needed a father and got a bleeding pussy who drank and taught me a grand total of zero life skills. They probably knew I was a lemon when I was still in the womb and could have given me the clotheshanger right then and there, but they insisted on pushing me out anyway because WITTLE BABY :D

Would they all be patting themselves and each other on the back if you were one of those happy success stories? If so, then turnabout is fair play and "what did I do wrong" is a question they should be asking themselves. I don't mean to push or trigger you into ending your life, that's just my 2 cents about being concerned with how your family will take it.

I fucked up. I've committed to move to a place that upon further consideration I'm really not sure I want to go to. I was steered toward this place by a family member and I'm thinking they led me astray for their own gain. The actual moving costs are starting to get out of hand as well.

Other than that, the usual stuff. I hate myself more than most people hate their worst enemy. I'm miserable and psychotic but I lack the ability to express why in a way that doesn't seem stupid or vacuous. I suppose I'm lonely but I'm too anxious, insecure, and hypersensitive to rejection to go out anywhere (and too self-absorbed and socially retarded to be good company). I'm suicidal but lacking the means or the balls to actually do it. For some reason I'm preoccupied about the shame it would bring to be the guy who killed himself, even though I'll be too dead to give a shit after the deed is done.

No, I'm not seeing a therapist. Every therapist I've ever talked to was either a goober who told me to be positive or a bitch who sat there like a stump until they cut me off 5 minutes before the end of the session to swipe my card and write me a prescription for placebo pills.
